messages:
paul.h: Heads-up: new flakiness in the Android sample where non-replayable POSTs get duplicated when Authenticator refreshes the token. Repro below.

paul.h: Repro: emulator API 30, OkHttp 4.10, Retrofit 2.9. Endpoint accepts JSON + binary chunk streamed via RequestBody. Flow: App interceptor adds Authorization header, server returns 401, OkHttp Authenticator refreshes token and retries. Occasionally server receives the full payload twice.

meera.s: Do you have retryOnConnectionFailure enabled? That can replay requests on a fresh connection if the body can't be replayed.

paul.h: Yes default true. We also saw this more often under HTTP/2 multiplexing.

tom.b: Two things to consider: (1) Make streaming bodies replayable (buffer small uploads) or (2) disable automatic replay for clients used for uploads. Also serialize refresh so only one thread hits the refresh endpoint.

paul.h: We implemented a synchronized refresh wrapper and that cut occurrences by ~80% but didn't eliminate them under heavy load. Disabling retryOnConnectionFailure for the upload client stopped duplicates in our smoke runs.

meera.s: For SDK parity note: server-side Java SDK already exposes an "uploadClient" with retry disabled and a helper for buffered bodies. Android samples should show the same pattern.

paul.h: Agree. I can add two sample clients in android-samples: defaultClient() and uploadClient() with retryOnConnectionFailure=false and a short comment about memory tradeoffs.

tom.b: Also add a docs snippet recommending upload idempotency tokens (X-Upload-Id) for servers so duplicates are handled safely.

paul.h: Will open PR with: (A) uploadClient sample, (B) small BufferedRequestBody sample (with warning <5MB), (C) a short guide "Auth refresh + non-replayable requests".

ci-bot: created PR #4921: android-samples: add uploadClient + docs for non-replayable bodies assigned to @paul.h

meera.s: One more runtime trick: log a warning if a RequestBody reports unknown contentLength() while client has retryOnConnectionFailure=true. That should help surface misconfigs early.

paul.h: Nice—I'll add that runtime check to the sample builder and run the emulator matrix (API 29/30/31, h2 vs h1). Thanks folks.
